reviews.text: The bests vets ever. Reception are amazing and every nurse and vet Coco has seen are brilliant too. Highly recommend if you're looking for a special place and to be well looked after 5*
Medivet Canonbury gave me an emergency appointment for my cat. The vet Eleni was kind and sorted out his problem . Very grateful. Excellent and fair

Leo & the Canonbury team
The team always take super good care of our now elderly Labrador

Thsnkyou

I had an excellent experience with Medivet Canonbury. After a deeply frustrating experience with another local vet, Leo and the team were quick and responsive when I explained that my senior cat urgently needed dental treatment (the other practice were prepared to leave it 3 weeks). He was in some distress, and Leo was incredibly transparent, kind and thorough. The aftercare has also been excellent. I would highly recommend them, including over other branches of Medi Vet that I spoke to in my search for urgent care.

Thank you very much for the 5-star review, Benjamin. 
We really appreciate your support and are delighted to know you had a positive experience with us at Medivet Canonbury!

I contacted Medivet Canonbury regarding the paperwork and EHC for our dog’s export to the UAE.

Dr. Leo, the Official Veterinarian, was incredibly helpful, knowledgeable, and experienced with the process of exporting a dog to the UAE. His service was truly exceptional, and he went above and beyond to make the process as smooth as possible.

The entire team at Medivet Canonbury was wonderful as well. A special mention to Paul at the front desk, who was absolutely outstanding—friendly, helpful, and incredibly supportive throughout.

I am extremely grateful for all their help and would highly recommend Medivet Canonbury to anyone needing veterinary assistance with pet travel and export documentation.
